# Oit — Real-Time Messaging & Voice/Video Rooms
> High-performance, lightweight real-time communication platform engineered for developer teams and tech communities.

## Overview
Oit (https://oit-seven.vercel.app) is an open-source, web-first communication platform combining instant text messaging, low-latency group voice and HD video rooms, and encrypted channels with zero bloat and zero installation required.

## Key Capabilities
- **Sub-Millisecond Real-Time Chat**: Optimistic local state updates synchronized over PostgreSQL Write-Ahead Log (WAL) replication and Supabase Realtime WebSockets.
- **Ultra Low-Latency Voice & Video**: WebRTC audio/video rooms powered by LiveKit Cloud Selective Forwarding Unit (SFU) infrastructure, featuring persistent floating calls, screen sharing, and active speaker DSP audio metering.
- **PIN-Locked Encrypted Channels**: Granular room-level security enforced by custom numeric PIN verification and database-level Row-Level Security (RLS) policies.
- **4-Tier Server Hierarchy**: Community spaces with Owner, Admin, Moderator, and Member permissions, invite links, and live presence signaling.
- **Instant Browser PWA**: Fully installable Progressive Web App across iOS, Android, macOS, and Windows.

## Technical Architecture
- **Client Layer**: Next.js 16 (App Router), React 19, Zustand state management, Tailwind CSS dark glassmorphic design system.
- **Database & Auth Layer**: Supabase Auth (JWT session claims), PostgreSQL with strict RLS policies, Supabase Storage for chat attachments.
- **Real-Time Media & Signaling**: Supabase Realtime CDC engine for presence & chat; LiveKit Cloud SFU for low-latency WebRTC media streams.
